name: Registry freshness gate
description: Before replaying deltas, confirm each registry entry points to an existing partition manifest and that the manifest hash still matches the recorded registry value.
quality_gate: Fail closed when a manifest is missing, changed without registry refresh, or has a duplicate partition_id.

name: Delta idempotency gate
description: Replay index deltas by delta_id and replay_policy.idempotency_key so duplicate writes do not create duplicate index records.
quality_gate: Fail when delta_id values repeat unexpectedly, operation values are unsupported, or replayed_record_count diverges from expected index-state counts.

name: Index record content hash gate
description: Recompute a stable hash over each index_record payload and compare it with the delta content_hash before applying the operation.
quality_gate: Fail when a delta content_hash does not match the embedded index_record payload.

name: Partition repair replay
description: When one shard needs repair, rebuild only that partition's manifest and delta file, refresh the partition registry, and replay affected deltas into keyword, vector, graph, facet, quality, and freshness indexes.
quality_gate: Repair jobs should emit a replay report before publishing changed index state.
